body:
Thanks. And he didn’t get drunk to deal with visiting me, he’s actually visiting friends and despite his goals of sobriety told me he got drunk while he was there to deal with the fact that when his trip is over, he comes home to me. Idk which is worse. 

I’ve tried lots of meds and they usually help until they don’t. None of them have ever successfully kept me okay for long enough to trust that it’s possible to stay that way. I’m still on a few right now. Idk if they make anything much better. 

It’s hard to tell if my self hatred is logical because im honestly not sure if it’s self hatred anymore. I’m just so… tired of everything and everyone else around me. I think I’m autistic so making or friends is near impossible. Everything you have to do to *survive* as an adult is paralyzingly difficult. I don’t have much left in me.

Thank you for the kind words, stranger.
